msg: warning: Variable family is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 581635e28f1.c (Apache httpd). Dead store on 'family' at line 7, presence condition True. When APR_HAVE_IPV6=true: family = 6 (APR_INET6 is defined) but never used — simplification artifact (real code uses family to configure URL parsing). When APR_HAVE_IPV6=false: APR_INET6 is undefined, tool treats it as 0, and reports dead store instead of UndeclaredIdentifier. In both cases the dead store alarm is a false positive.
